home-redirect.name: Home redirects by session
home-redirect.description: Opening / sends visitors without a session to /sign-in and signed-in operators to /dashboard

auth-sign-in-form.name: Sign-in form display and interaction
auth-sign-in-form.description: Operator opens /sign-in, can type in the form and an empty submission keeps them on the page

auth-login-invalid.name: Login with invalid credentials
auth-login-invalid.description: Operator submits rejected credentials, sees the error and stays on /sign-in

auth-login-success.name: Login with valid credentials
auth-login-success.description: Operator submits accepted credentials and lands on the /dashboard console

auth-protected-redirect.name: Protected route redirect
auth-protected-redirect.description: Opening /dashboard without a session redirects to /sign-in

auth-sign-out.name: Sign out from the console
auth-sign-out.description: Signed-in operator uses the header sign-out button and returns to /sign-in

auth-forgot-password-form.name: Forgot password form display
auth-forgot-password-form.description: Operator follows the sign-in link to /forgot-password and sees the reset form

auth-forgot-password-send-code.name: Forgot password sends the passcode
auth-forgot-password-send-code.description: Operator requests a passcode and moves to the code and new-password step; a backend failure shows an error

dashboard-empty-state.name: Console empty state
dashboard-empty-state.description: Signed-in operator sees the Fiscal. console with the empty documents state

i18n-locale-switch.name: Switch the interface language
i18n-locale-switch.description: Operator switches the interface from Spanish (default) to English

navigation-unknown-route.name: Unknown route returns 404
navigation-unknown-route.description: Navigating to an undefined URL returns an HTTP 404 status instead of a broken 200/500
